work.heading: My work
work.codex.summary: I design solutions for government agencies based on data for better decisions. Projects and clients under NDA.
work.codex.projectA.title: Project A
work.codex.projectA.desc: We reduced the time to detect and respond to fires in a specific biome in Brazil. The platform allows automated detection every 10 minutes, prioritization of the most serious cases, and direct communication with the responsible agencies, sending the exact geographic coordinates of the fire.
work.codex.projectA.impact: response time reduced from 2 days to 10 minutes
work.codex.projectB.title: Project B
work.codex.projectB.desc: We transformed geospatial environmental intelligence into strategic support for the granting of rural credit in Brazil. I designed a centralized experience that converts complex geospatial data into instant actionable intelligence.
work.pixeon.summary: I designed hospital and healthcare solutions focused on high reliability and performance.
work.pixeon.item1: I conducted a usability test on an internal product and identified opportunities to improve it before it goes to users.
work.pixeon.item2: I reviewed the booking flow for exams based on user data, identified hypotheses for the high abandonment rate, and suggested anticipating which documents are required to book and testing whether that reduces the rate.
work.pixeon.item3: I designed AI conversation flows for a chatbot booking exams.
work.pixeon.impact: I led the ideation and creation of high-fidelity prototypes to validate Product-Market Fit with stakeholders and end-users. This visual materialization was crucial in supporting strategic business decisions that resulted in the largest sale in the company's history within this segment.
